module
public import Eggshell.CanonicalSourcePrepared
public import tools.research.OwnerMetadataImage
public import tools.research.SourceViewBatch
public import Std.Sync.Mutex
@[expose] public section

namespace Eggshell.Synapses.SharedReadViews
open Lean DB

def capacity : Nat := 128*1024*1024
def maxImages : Nat := 8
def maxQueued : Nat := 128
def charge (wireBytes : Nat) : Nat := 65536+32*wireBytes

structure Source where
  scope : String
  source : PageMap.Head
  loaded : CanonicalSource.Shared.Loaded
  owners : Std.HashSet String
  order : Array String
  metadata : OwnerMetadataImage.Image
  records : Std.HashMap String (Option ObservedRecordView.Geometry) := {}
  recordBytes : Nat := 0

/-- Called only after the complete query-view reservation. Values are shared
immutable references; later reads cannot reenter the metadata-cache owner. -/
def Source.capture (scope : String) (source : PageMap.Head)
    (loaded : CanonicalSource.Shared.Loaded) (owners : Array String) (deadline : Nat)
    (structures : Option ObservedRecordView.Cache := none) : IO Source := do
  let owners := SourceViewBatch.canonicalOwners owners
  let mut metadata : OwnerMetadataImage.Image := ⟨loaded.identity,{}⟩
  for owner in owners do
    let ready ← loaded.withMetadata owner deadline pure
    metadata := metadata.insert owner ready
  let batch ← match structures with
    | none => pure ({} : ObservedRecordView.Batch)
    | some cache => do
      let some original := loaded.originals | throw (IO.userError "original record view is not prepared")
      cache.project original.index source.identity owners deadline (16*1024*1024-4096)
  return {
    scope := scope
    source := source
    loaded := loaded
    owners := Std.HashSet.ofArray owners
    order := owners
    metadata := metadata
    records := Std.HashMap.ofArray batch.rows
    recordBytes := batch.bytes }

def Source.readRecords (source : Source) (owners : Array String) :
    Except String (Array (String × Option ObservedRecordView.Geometry)) :=
  owners.mapM fun owner => do
    unless source.owners.contains owner do throw "original records cross the pinned owner domain"
    let some value := source.records[owner]? | throw "original records are not captured in the pinned view"
    return (owner,value)

def Source.capturedBytes (source : Source) : Nat :=
  source.recordBytes+source.metadata.values.fold (fun bytes _ ready => bytes+ready.bytes) 0

theorem Source.geometry_is_charged (source : Source) : source.recordBytes ≤ source.capturedBytes :=
  Nat.le_add_right _ _

def Source.readMetadata (source : Source) (owner : String) : Except String PreparedSourceView.OwnerReady :=
  PreparedSourceView.requireSome (source.metadata.lookup? source.loaded.identity owner)
    "owner metadata is outside the pinned view"

theorem Source.metadata_lookup (source : Source) (owner : String) :
    source.readMetadata owner =
      PreparedSourceView.requireSome (source.metadata.lookup? source.loaded.identity owner)
        "owner metadata is outside the pinned view" := rfl

/-- Selection reads only the immutable metadata captured under the existing
query reservation. It cannot acquire a cache lock or wait for a fill. -/
def Source.focusWindows (source : Source) (owner work : String) (windows : List String)
    (question : String) (semantic : List Nat) : Except String (List Nat) :=
  source.metadata.focusWindows source.loaded.identity owner work windows question semantic

theorem Source.focus_is_captured_read (source : Source) (owner work : String)
    (windows : List String) (question : String) (semantic : List Nat) :
    source.focusWindows owner work windows question semantic =
      source.metadata.focusWindows source.loaded.identity owner work windows question semantic := rfl

/-- Authorization scope and complete original content are independent of a
request's question, deadline and private lease. -/
structure Key where
  scope : String
  contents : String
  deriving BEq, ReflBEq, LawfulBEq, Hashable

def contents (sources : Array Source) : String :=
  (toJson (sources.map fun source =>
    (toJson (source.source.identity,source.scope,source.source,source.loaded.metadata),
      SourceViewBatch.canonicalOwners source.order))).compress

def capturedBytes (sources : Array Source) : Nat := sources.foldl (fun bytes source => bytes+source.capturedBytes) 0
def leaseCharge (key : Key) : Nat := 1024+4*(key.scope.utf8ByteSize+key.contents.utf8ByteSize)

structure Image where
  binding : String
  sources : Array Source
  wireBytes : Nat
  stamp : Nat
  bound : contents sources = binding
  covered : capturedBytes sources ≤ wireBytes

def Image.charge (image : Image) := SharedReadViews.charge image.wireBytes

def Image.prepare (binding : String) (sources : Array Source) (wireBytes stamp : Nat) : Except String Image :=
  if bound : contents sources = binding then
    if covered : capturedBytes sources ≤ wireBytes then .ok ⟨binding,sources,wireBytes,stamp,bound,covered⟩
    else .error "original image exceeded its counted bytes"
  else .error "original image changed its complete source/owner boundary"

theorem Image.original_boundary (image : Image) : contents image.sources = image.binding := image.bound

structure View where
  key : Key
  image : Option Image := none
  deadline : Nat
  wireBytes : Nat
  borrowers : Nat := 0
  released : Bool := false

def View.scope (view : View) := view.key.scope
def View.sources (view : View) := view.image.map (·.sources) |>.getD #[]
def View.charge (view : View) := SharedReadViews.charge view.wireBytes
def View.ofImage (key : Key) (image : Image) (deadline : Nat) : View :=
  {key,image := some image,deadline,wireBytes := image.wireBytes}

theorem View.shared_sources (key : Key) (image : Image) (deadline : Nat) :
    (View.ofImage key image deadline).sources = image.sources := rfl
theorem View.private_deadline (key : Key) (image : Image) (deadline : Nat) :
    (View.ofImage key image deadline).deadline = deadline := rfl
theorem View.private_scope (key : Key) (image : Image) (deadline : Nat) :
    (View.ofImage key image deadline).scope = key.scope := rfl
theorem View.released_independent (key other : Key) (image : Image) (first second : Nat) :
    ({View.ofImage key image first with released := true}).sources =
      (View.ofImage other image second).sources := rfl

structure Projection where
  owners : Array (Array (String × OwnerPalette.Descriptor))
  records : Array (Array (String × Option ObservedRecordView.Geometry))
  focus : Array (Array (String × List Nat))
  literals : Array (Array (String × Option Eggshell.Research.PreparedLiteralFocus.Data))

/-- Pure reads receive only an immutable image and the current request. Admission,
release, cache state and IO capabilities are absent from this computation. The
request's order is preserved even when different permutations share an image. -/
def View.project (view : View) (requests : Array SourceViewBatch.Request) : Except String Projection := do
  unless view.sources.size == requests.size do throw "original batch changed its source count"
  let mut values := #[]
  let mut records := #[]
  let mut focused := #[]
  let mut literals := #[]
  for (entry,request) in view.sources.zip requests do
    unless entry.scope == request.access.scope && entry.source == request.access.source &&
        entry.loaded.metadata == request.access.metadata && request.owners.all entry.owners.contains do
      throw "original batch changed its immutable read domain"
    let metadata ← request.owners.mapM fun owner => do
      let ready ← entry.readMetadata owner
      return (owner,ready.stored.descriptor,ready.focus.map (·.stored.literalData))
    values := values.push (metadata.map fun (owner,descriptor,_) => (owner,descriptor))
    literals := literals.push (metadata.map fun (owner,_,facts) => (owner,facts))
    records := records.push (← entry.readRecords request.owners)
    let ranked ← match request.focus with
      | none => pure #[]
      | some focus => focus.rows.mapM fun row => do
          return (row.owner,← entry.focusWindows row.owner row.work row.windows focus.question row.semantic)
    focused := focused.push ranked
  return ⟨values,records,focused,literals⟩

theorem View.project_private_lifetime (view : View) (requests : Array SourceViewBatch.Request)
    (deadline borrowers : Nat) (released : Bool) :
    ({view with deadline,borrowers,released}).project requests = view.project requests := rfl

theorem View.project_shared_image (key other : Key) (image : Image) (first second : Nat)
    (requests : Array SourceViewBatch.Request) :
    (View.ofImage key image first).project requests =
      (View.ofImage other image second).project requests := rfl

structure State where
  active : Std.HashMap String View := {}
  images : Std.HashMap String Image := {}
  waiting : List Nat := []
  next : Nat := 0
  closed : Bool := false
  admitted : Nat := 0
  released : Nat := 0
  expired : Nat := 0
  peak : Nat := 0
  clock : Nat := 0
  hits : Nat := 0
  builds : Nat := 0
  evictions : Nat := 0

def State.residentBytes (state : State) := state.images.fold (fun bytes _ image => bytes+image.charge) 0
def State.leaseBytes (state : State) := state.active.fold (fun bytes _ view => bytes+leaseCharge view.key) 0
def State.buildingBytes (state : State) := state.active.fold (fun bytes _ view =>
  bytes+(if view.image.isNone then view.charge else 0)) 0
def State.building (state : State) := state.active.fold (fun count _ view =>
  count+(if view.image.isNone then 1 else 0)) 0
def State.used (state : State) := state.residentBytes+state.leaseBytes+state.buildingBytes
def State.referenced (state : State) (binding : String) :=
  state.active.fold (fun found _ view => found || view.key.contents == binding) false

def State.Valid (state : State) : Prop := state.used ≤ capacity ∧
  state.images.size+state.building ≤ maxImages ∧ state.active.size ≤ AdmissionLimits.operations ∧
  state.images.toArray.all (fun (binding,image) => image.binding == binding) = true ∧
  state.active.toArray.all (fun (_,view) => view.image.all (fun image => image.binding == view.key.contents)) = true

instance (state : State) : Decidable state.Valid := by unfold State.Valid; infer_instance

structure Checked where
  value : State
  valid : value.Valid

def State.checked (state : State) : Except String Checked :=
  if valid : state.Valid then .ok ⟨state,valid⟩ else .error "shared original view accounting exceeded its fixed bounds"

theorem Checked.byte_bound (state : Checked) : state.value.used ≤ capacity := state.valid.1
theorem Checked.image_bound (state : Checked) : state.value.images.size+state.value.building ≤ 8 := state.valid.2.1
theorem Checked.lease_bound (state : Checked) : state.value.active.size ≤ AdmissionLimits.operations := state.valid.2.2.1

/-- Expiration forbids new work, but cannot pretend that a still-running
borrower has released its memory. Its reservation ends in the finalizer. -/
def State.reap (state : State) (now : Nat) : State :=
  let expired := state.active.fold (fun total _ view => total+
    if !view.released && view.deadline ≤ now && view.borrowers == 0 then 1 else 0) 0
  let active := state.active.filter fun _ view =>
    0 < view.borrowers || (!view.released && now < view.deadline)
  let images := if state.closed then state.images.filter fun key _ =>
    active.fold (fun found _ view => found || view.key.contents == key) false else state.images
  {state with active,images,expired := state.expired+expired}

def State.reclaim (state : State) (amount : Nat) (slot : Bool) (preserve : String) : Nat → State
  | 0 => state
  | fuel+1 =>
    if state.used+amount ≤ capacity && (!slot || state.images.size+state.building < maxImages) then state else
    let idle := state.images.toArray.filter fun (key,_) => key != preserve && !state.referenced key
    match (idle.qsort fun a b => a.2.stamp < b.2.stamp)[0]? with
    | none => state
    | some (key,_) => reclaim {state with images := state.images.erase key,evictions := state.evictions+1}
        amount slot preserve fuel

structure Admission where
  token : String
  resident : Bool

structure Pool where
  state : Std.Mutex Checked

def Pool.new : IO Pool := do
  let empty ← IO.ofExcept (({} : State).checked)
  return ⟨← Std.Mutex.new empty⟩

/-- A hit only creates a private lifetime handle. The resident image and its
replacement stamp are unchanged. The caller authenticates every source first. -/
def Pool.borrow? (pool : Pool) (key : Key) (deadline : Nat) : IO (Option (String × Nat)) := do
  let now ← IO.monoMsNow
  unless now < deadline do throw (IO.userError "original view request expired")
  let token := Blake3.hex (← IO.getRandomBytes 32)
  pool.state.atomically do
    let state := (← get).value.reap now
    unless !state.closed do throw (IO.userError "original view admission stopped")
    let some image := state.images[key.contents]? | set (← IO.ofExcept state.checked); return none
    let state := state.reclaim (leaseCharge key) false key.contents maxImages
    unless state.active.size < AdmissionLimits.operations && state.used+leaseCharge key ≤ capacity do
      set (← IO.ofExcept state.checked)
      return none
    unless !state.active.contains token do throw (IO.userError "original view token collision")
    let next : State := {
      state with
      active := state.active.insert token (View.ofImage key image deadline)
      admitted := state.admitted+1
      hits := state.hits+1
      peak := max state.peak (state.used+leaseCharge key)}
    set (← IO.ofExcept next.checked)
    return some (token,image.wireBytes)

def Pool.reserve (pool : Pool) (key : Key) (wireBytes deadline : Nat) : IO Admission := do
  let amount := charge wireBytes
  unless amount+leaseCharge key ≤ capacity do throw (IO.userError "original view exceeds its query budget")
  let token := Blake3.hex (← IO.getRandomBytes 32)
  let ticket ← pool.state.atomically do
    let state := (← get).value
    unless !state.closed && state.waiting.length < maxQueued do
      throw (IO.userError "original view admission is stopped or full")
    set (← IO.ofExcept ({state with waiting := state.waiting ++ [state.next],next := state.next+1}).checked)
    return state.next
  try
    repeat
      let now ← IO.monoMsNow
      unless now < deadline do throw (IO.userError "original view admission expired")
      let token ← pool.state.atomically do
        let state := (← get).value.reap now
        unless !state.closed do throw (IO.userError "original view admission stopped")
        let image := state.images[key.contents]?
        let needed := leaseCharge key+(if image.isSome then 0 else amount)
        let state := state.reclaim needed image.isNone key.contents maxImages
        if state.waiting.head? == some ticket && state.active.size < AdmissionLimits.operations &&
            state.used+needed ≤ capacity && (image.isSome || state.images.size+state.building < maxImages) then
          unless !state.active.contains token do throw (IO.userError "original view token collision")
          let view ← match image with
            | some image => pure (View.ofImage key image deadline)
            | none => pure ({key,deadline,wireBytes} : View)
          let next : State := {
            state with
            active := state.active.insert token view
            waiting := state.waiting.drop 1
            admitted := state.admitted+1
            hits := state.hits+(if image.isSome then 1 else 0)
            peak := max state.peak (state.used+needed)}
          set (← IO.ofExcept next.checked)
          return some ({token,resident := image.isSome} : Admission)
        set (← IO.ofExcept state.checked)
        return none
      if let some token := token then return token
      IO.sleep 2
    throw (IO.userError "unreachable original view admission")
  finally pool.state.atomically do
    let state := (← get).value
    set (← IO.ofExcept ({state with waiting := state.waiting.filter (· != ticket)}).checked)

def Pool.attach (pool : Pool) (token scope : String) (sources : Array Source) : IO Unit := do
  -- Content serialization and geometry accounting inspect immutable data. They
  -- run under the existing build reservation, never under the registry mutex.
  let prepared ← IO.ofExcept (Image.prepare (contents sources) sources (capturedBytes sources) 0)
  let now ← IO.monoMsNow
  pool.state.atomically do
    let state := (← get).value.reap now
    let some view := state.active[token]? | throw (IO.userError "original view expired before binding")
    unless !state.closed && !view.released && now < view.deadline && view.scope == scope &&
        view.sources.isEmpty && !sources.isEmpty do throw (IO.userError "original view binding changed its scope")
    unless prepared.binding == view.key.contents && prepared.wireBytes ≤ view.wireBytes do
      throw (IO.userError "original image changed its reserved source/owner boundary")
    let (image,images,clock,builds,hits) ← match state.images[view.key.contents]? with
      | some image => pure (image,state.images,state.clock,state.builds,state.hits+1)
      | none =>
        let prepared := {prepared with stamp := state.clock+1}
        pure (prepared,state.images.insert view.key.contents prepared,state.clock+1,state.builds+1,state.hits)
    let next : State := {
      state with
      images := images
      clock := clock
      builds := builds
      hits := hits
      active := state.active.insert token (View.ofImage view.key image view.deadline)}
    set (← IO.ofExcept next.checked)

def Pool.acquire (pool : Pool) (scope : String) (source : PageMap.Head)
    (loaded : CanonicalSource.Shared.Loaded) (owners : Array String) (wireBytes deadline : Nat) : IO String := do
  let identity := toJson (source.identity,scope,source,loaded.metadata)
  let key : Key := ⟨scope,(toJson #[(identity,SourceViewBatch.canonicalOwners owners)]).compress⟩
  if let some (token,_) ← pool.borrow? key deadline then return token
  let admission ← pool.reserve key wireBytes deadline
  let token := admission.token
  try
    unless admission.resident do
      let captured ← Source.capture scope source loaded owners deadline
      pool.attach token scope #[captured]
    return token
  catch error =>
    pool.state.atomically do
      let state := (← get).value
      set (← IO.ofExcept ({state with active := state.active.erase token}).checked)
    throw error

def Pool.validateView (pool : Pool) (token scope : String) : IO View := do
  let now ← IO.monoMsNow
  pool.state.atomically do
    let state := (← get).value.reap now
    set (← IO.ofExcept state.checked)
    let some view := state.active[token]? | throw (IO.userError "original view expired or released")
    unless !state.closed && !view.released && now < view.deadline && view.scope == scope && !view.sources.isEmpty do
      throw (IO.userError "original view changed its read domain")
    return view

def Pool.validate (pool : Pool) (token scope : String) (source : PageMap.Head)
    (owners : Array String) : IO (CanonicalSource.Shared.Loaded × Nat) := do
  let view ← pool.validateView token scope
  let some entry := view.sources.find? (fun entry => entry.scope == scope && entry.source == source) |
    throw (IO.userError "original view has no requested source")
  unless owners.all entry.owners.contains do throw (IO.userError "original view has no requested owner")
  return (entry.loaded,view.deadline)

def Pool.withView (pool : Pool) (token scope : String) (use : View → IO α) : IO α := do
  let now ← IO.monoMsNow
  let view ← pool.state.atomically do
    let state := (← get).value.reap now
    let some view := state.active[token]? | throw (IO.userError "original view expired or released")
    unless !state.closed && !view.released && now < view.deadline && view.scope == scope && !view.sources.isEmpty do
      throw (IO.userError "original view changed its read domain")
    set (← IO.ofExcept ({state with active := state.active.insert token {view with borrowers := view.borrowers+1}}).checked)
    return view
  try use view
  finally
    let now ← IO.monoMsNow
    pool.state.atomically do
      let state := (← get).value
      let some view := state.active[token]? | return
      set (← IO.ofExcept ({state with active := state.active.insert token {view with borrowers := view.borrowers-1}}.reap now).checked)

def Pool.release (pool : Pool) (token scope : String) : IO Unit := pool.state.atomically do
  let state := (← get).value
  let some view := state.active[token]? | return
  unless view.scope == scope do throw (IO.userError "original view release crossed read scope")
  if view.released then return
  let active := if view.borrowers == 0 then state.active.erase token else
    state.active.insert token {view with released := true}
  set (← IO.ofExcept ({state with active,released := state.released+1}).checked)

def Pool.close (pool : Pool) : IO Unit := pool.state.atomically do
  let state := (← get).value
  let active := state.active.filterMap fun _ view =>
    if view.borrowers == 0 then none else some {view with released := true}
  let next := ({state with closed := true,active,waiting := []}).reap 0
  set (← IO.ofExcept next.checked)

def Pool.stats (pool : Pool) : IO Json := pool.state.atomically do
  let state := (← get).value
  return Json.mkObj [("active",toJson state.active.size),("queued",toJson state.waiting.length),
    ("chargedBytes",toJson state.used),("capacity",toJson capacity),("peakChargedBytes",toJson state.peak),
    ("admitted",toJson state.admitted),("released",toJson state.released),("expired",toJson state.expired),
    ("closed",toJson state.closed),("images",toJson state.images.size),("building",toJson state.building),
    ("residentBytes",toJson state.residentBytes),("leaseBytes",toJson state.leaseBytes),
    ("buildingBytes",toJson state.buildingBytes),("builds",toJson state.builds),("hits",toJson state.hits),
    ("evictions",toJson state.evictions),("maxImages",toJson maxImages),
    ("maxLeases",toJson AdmissionLimits.operations)]

end Eggshell.Synapses.SharedReadViews

namespace Eggshell.Research.ViewAdmissionProof
open Eggshell.Synapses.SharedReadViews

theorem reap_keeps_borrower (state : State) (token : String) (view : View) (now : Nat)
    (found : state.active[token]? = some view) (borrowed : 0 < view.borrowers) :
    (state.reap now).active[token]? = some view := by
  simp [State.reap,found,borrowed]

theorem reap_released_idle (state : State) (token : String) (view : View) (now : Nat)
    (found : state.active[token]? = some view) (idle : view.borrowers = 0)
    (released : view.released = true) : (state.reap now).active[token]? = none := by
  simp [State.reap,found,idle,released]

#print axioms reap_keeps_borrower
#print axioms reap_released_idle
#print axioms Checked.byte_bound
#print axioms Checked.lease_bound
#print axioms View.project_private_lifetime
#print axioms View.project_shared_image
end Eggshell.Research.ViewAdmissionProof

import tools.research.ViewAdmissionProof
import Init.System.Promise
open Lean Eggshell Eggshell.Synapses.SharedReadViews

namespace Eggshell.Research.ViewAdmissionProbe
def check (ok : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit := unless ok do throw (IO.userError message)
def key (i : Nat) : Key := ⟨s!"probe-scope-{i}",s!"probe-content-{i}"⟩

/-- Sixteen distinct preparations remain live together until every caller
settles. These are admission handles, not fabricated readable sources. -/
def concurrent (pool : Pool) : IO Json := do
  let launch ← IO.Promise.new (α := Nat)
  let release ← IO.Promise.new (α := Unit)
  let settled ← (Array.range 16).mapM fun _ => IO.Promise.new (α := Json)
  let tasks ← settled.mapIdxM fun i status => IO.asTask (do
    let deadline ← IO.wait launch.result!
    let began ← IO.monoMsNow
    try
      let admitted ← pool.reserve (key i) 0 deadline
      try
        status.resolve (Json.mkObj [("client",toJson i),("admitted",toJson true),
          ("elapsedMs",toJson ((← IO.monoMsNow)-began)),("resident",toJson admitted.resident)])
        discard <| IO.wait release.result!
      finally pool.release admitted.token (key i).scope
    catch error => status.resolve (Json.mkObj [("client",toJson i),("admitted",toJson false),
      ("elapsedMs",toJson ((← IO.monoMsNow)-began)),("error",toJson error.toString)])) .dedicated
  let began ← IO.monoMsNow
  try
    launch.resolve (began+1000)
    while !(← settled.allM (·.isResolved)) do
      check ((← IO.monoMsNow) < began+3000) "admission callers did not settle"
      IO.sleep 1
    let elapsed := (← IO.monoMsNow)-began
    let rows ← settled.mapM fun promise => IO.wait promise.result!
    let admitted := rows.countP (fun row => row.getObjValD "admitted" == toJson true)
    let barrier ← pool.stats
    check (barrier.getObjValD "active" == toJson admitted &&
      barrier.getObjValD "building" == toJson admitted &&
      barrier.getObjValD "queued" == toJson (0 : Nat)) "barrier lost live admission accounting"
    release.resolve ()
    for task in tasks do discard <| IO.ofExcept (← IO.wait task)
    let drained ← pool.stats
    check (drained.getObjValD "active" == toJson (0 : Nat) &&
      drained.getObjValD "chargedBytes" == toJson (0 : Nat)) "released preparations retained a reservation"
    return Json.mkObj [("clients",toJson (16 : Nat)),("admittedTogether",toJson admitted),
      ("wallMs",toJson elapsed),("deadlineMs",toJson (1000 : Nat)),("rows",toJson rows),
      ("barrier",barrier),("drained",drained)]
  finally
    launch.resolve (began+1000)
    release.resolve ()
    for task in tasks do IO.cancel task
    for task in tasks do discard <| IO.wait task

def boundaries (pool : Pool) : IO Json := do
  let admitted ← pool.reserve (key 99) 0 ((← IO.monoMsNow)+1000)
  let wrongScope ← try pool.release admitted.token "foreign-scope"; pure false catch _ => pure true
  let unreadable ← try discard <| pool.validateView admitted.token (key 99).scope; pure false catch _ => pure true
  check (wrongScope && unreadable && (← pool.stats).getObjValD "active" == toJson (1 : Nat))
    "an unprepared or foreign scope acquired authority"
  pool.release admitted.token (key 99).scope
  let overBudget ← try
    discard <| pool.reserve (key 100) capacity ((← IO.monoMsNow)+1000)
    pure false
    catch _ => pure true
  check (overBudget && (← pool.stats).getObjValD "active" == toJson (0 : Nat)) "byte budget was bypassed"
  return Json.mkObj [("foreignScopeRejected",toJson wrongScope),("unpreparedReadRejected",toJson unreadable),
    ("overBudgetRejected",toJson overBudget)]

def run (output : System.FilePath) : IO Unit := do
  check (output.isAbsolute && !(← output.pathExists)) "fresh native admission report required"
  IO.FS.createDirAll output
  let pool ← Pool.new
  try
    let batch ← concurrent pool
    let limits ← boundaries pool
    IO.FS.writeFile (output/"report.json") (Json.mkObj [("batch",batch),("boundaries",limits),
      ("syntheticAdmissionOnly",toJson true),("actualHookCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),
      ("answeringModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),("adopted",toJson false)]).compress
  finally pool.close
end Eggshell.Research.ViewAdmissionProbe

import tools.research.ViewAdmissionProbe
import tools.research.ReplayReadinessChecks
import tools.research.MemoryCapacity
import tools.research.NativeTrialAudit
open Lean Eggshell Eggshell.Plugin
namespace Eggshell.Research.LexicalGraphHooks
def check (ok : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit := unless ok do throw (IO.userError message)
def read (path : System.FilePath) : IO Json := IO.FS.readFile path >>= (IO.ofExcept ∘ Json.parse)
def save (path : System.FilePath) (value : Json) : IO Unit := IO.FS.writeFile path value.compress
structure Input where
  workload : MemoryCapacity.Input
  mode : String
  specifications : Array String
  frozen : Array String
  lexicalReference : Option String := none
  deriving FromJson
def body (output : String) : Except String String := do
  let parsed ← Json.parse output
  (parsed.getObjValD "hookSpecificOutput").getObjValAs? String "additionalContext"
def run (path : System.FilePath) : IO Unit := do
  let input ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (← read path) : Except String Input)
  let work := input.workload
  let root : System.FilePath := .mk work.output
  check (root.isAbsolute && !(← root.pathExists) && input.specifications.size == 3 && input.frozen.size == 3) "fresh full-hook control inputs required"
  check (["normal","lexical","before-ready","after-ready","legacy-after-ready"].contains input.mode) "unknown fixed fault mode"
  check (work.topics.map (·.topic) == #[1,2,3] && work.handoffChars == 500000) "frozen three-topic envelope changed"
  for topic in work.topics do
    check ((← MemoryCapacity.hash (.mk topic.body)) == topic.sha256) "canonical semantic body changed"
  check ((← IO.getEnv "EGGSHELL_RESEARCH_PHASE_FAULT").getD "normal" == input.mode) "fault mode differs from controlled daemon environment"
  check ((← MemoryCapacity.hash (.mk work.runtime)) == work.runtimeSha256) "frozen runtime changed"
  check ((← StudyRuntime.files (.mk work.project)) == work.sourceFiles) "original source publication changed"
  IO.FS.createDirAll root
  let budget ← IO.ofExcept (StudyProfile.checked work.handoffChars)
  let config := StudyProfile.render work.runtime work.project budget false
  let config := if input.mode == "lexical" then config.replace
    ("semantic_matcher = "++(toJson #[work.runtime,"search-provider"]).compress++"\n") "semantic_matcher = false\n" else config
  IO.FS.writeFile (.mk work.config) config
  let publisher ← StudyRuntime.startPublisher (.mk work.runtime) (.mk work.data) work.environment
  try
    let warm ← StudyCommand.run work.runtime #["egg","warm","work"] work.environment work.workspace "" (root/"warm") 240000
    check (warm.exitCode == 0) "full-hook control warm failed"
    let managed ← StudyRuntime.startManaged (.mk work.runtime) (.mk work.plugin) "full-fallback-hooks"
      (System.FilePath.mk work.data/"daemon.json") work.environment
    try
      let mut rows := #[]
      for repetition in [:2] do
        for position in [:work.topics.size] do
          let some topic := work.topics[position]? | throw (IO.userError "missing fixed topic")
          let index := repetition*3+position
          let directory := root/s!"topic-{topic.topic}-chat-{repetition}"
          IO.FS.createDirAll directory
          let session := "fallback-hook-"++Sha256.hex s!"{root}:{index}".toUTF8
          let receipt ← Receipt.fresh
          let began ← IO.monoMsNow
          let deadline := began+30000
          discard <| Daemon.hookRequest (MemoryCapacity.request work session "SessionStart") deadline (← Receipt.fresh)
          let started ← IO.monoMsNow
          let deadline := started+30000
          let reply ← Daemon.hookRequest (MemoryCapacity.request work session "UserPromptSubmit" topic.prompt) deadline receipt
          let stdout := (← IO.ofExcept (reply.getObjValAs? String "output")).trimAscii.toString++"\n"
          IO.FS.writeFile (directory/"stdout") stdout
          let flushed ← IO.monoMsNow
          let complete := (Daemon.decodeHookReply (some reply)).isComplete
          Receipt.write receipt "published" (Json.mkObj [("output",toJson stdout),("sha256",toJson (Sha256.hex stdout.toUTF8)),
            ("bytes",toJson stdout.utf8ByteSize),("replyComplete",toJson complete),
            ("startedMs",toJson started),("flushedMs",toJson flushed),("deadlineMs",toJson deadline)])
          let delivered ← IO.ofExcept (body stdout)
          IO.FS.writeFile (directory/"body.txt") delivered
          let ack := reply.getObjValD "ack"
          let acknowledged ←
            if complete && ack != Json.null then do
              let endpoint ← Daemon.readyEndpoint session
              pure ((← Daemon.exchangeBefore endpoint "ack" ack deadline) == "true")
            else pure false
          let elapsed := (← IO.monoMsNow)-started
          Receipt.write receipt "ack" (Json.mkObj [("rpcCompleted",toJson true),("offerAccepted",toJson acknowledged)])
          let summary ← MemoryCapacity.receiptSummary work (Json.mkObj [("receipt",toJson receipt)])
          let audit ← NativeTrialAudit.replayAvailable (← read (.mk input.specifications[position]!))
            (directory/"body.txt").toString (Sha256.hex delivered.toUTF8)
          check (audit.getObjValD "availableEvidence" == (← read (.mk input.frozen[position]!))) "frozen needed evidence changed"
          save (directory/"audit.json") audit
          let expected ← if input.mode == "normal" then IO.FS.readFile (.mk topic.body)
            else if input.mode == "lexical" && repetition > 0 then
              IO.FS.readFile (root/s!"topic-{topic.topic}-chat-0/body.txt")
            else if let some reference := input.lexicalReference then
              IO.FS.readFile (System.FilePath.mk reference/s!"topic-{topic.topic}-chat-0/body.txt")
            else pure delivered
          let same := delivered == expected
          let route := (summary.getObjValD "search").getObjValD "trace" |>.getObjValD "route"
          if input.mode == "lexical" then
            check (((summary.getObjValD "search").getObjValD "trace").getObjValD "semantic" == toJson SemanticSearchStatus.notRequested)
              "direct lexical control still requested semantics"
          let row := Json.mkObj [("topic",toJson topic.topic),("repetition",toJson repetition),
            ("mode",toJson input.mode),("session",toJson session),("receipt",toJson receipt),
            ("elapsedMs",toJson elapsed),("bodyBytes",toJson delivered.utf8ByteSize),
            ("bodySha256",toJson (Sha256.hex delivered.toUTF8)),("bodyReferenceEqual",toJson same),
            ("replyComplete",toJson complete),("acknowledged",toJson acknowledged),("receiptSummary",summary),
            ("availableDelivery",audit.getObjValD "availableDelivery")]
          rows := rows.push row
          save (root/"progress.json") (toJson rows)
          if input.mode == "legacy-after-ready" then
            check (!acknowledged && delivered.utf8ByteSize < 1024) "legacy deadline unexpectedly delivered original body"
          else
            check (acknowledged && complete && same && elapsed < 30000) "full-hook body, reference, ACK or deadline check failed"
            if input.mode == "normal" then
              check ((audit.getObjValD "availableDelivery").getObjValD "targetMet" == toJson true) "normal/direct lexical delivery missed frozen originals"
            else if input.mode != "lexical" then check (route == toJson SearchRoute.lexical) "forced semantic failure did not use lexical route"
      check ((← StudyRuntime.files (.mk work.project)) == work.sourceFiles) "full-hook trial changed the original project"
      save (root/"result.json") (Json.mkObj [("mode",toJson input.mode),("rows",toJson rows),
        ("controlChecksPassed",toJson true),("allDeliveryTargetsMet",toJson (rows.all (fun row => (row.getObjValD "availableDelivery").getObjValD "targetMet" == toJson true))),("originalPublicationUnchanged",toJson true),
        ("answeringModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),("adopted",toJson false)])
    finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged managed (root/"frontend-shutdown.json")
  finally StudyRuntime.stopManaged publisher (root/"publisher-shutdown.json")
end Eggshell.Research.LexicalGraphHooks


run_elab do
  let env ← getEnv
  for target in [``Eggshell.Plugin.SharedRangeAdapter.plan,``Eggshell.Plugin.SharedRangeAdapter.selectPrepared,``Eggshell.Plugin.SharedRangeAdapter.selectView] do
    let some body := (env.find? target).bind (·.value?) | throwError "missing actual selector consumer"
    unless body.getUsedConstants.contains ``SharedCoverage.OwnedAdvance.chooseOwned &&
        !body.getUsedConstants.contains ``SharedCoverage.choose? do
      throwError "actual service selector bypasses the owned implementation"
